metaTitle: BMW Engine Bearing Replacement | BMW Garage
metaDescription: Professional BMW engine bearing replacement – main and rod bearings replaced as part of our full engine rebuild service. Precision measurement and factory tolerances guaranteed.
lede: Main and rod bearing replacement during our full engine rebuild service. We measure, match, and install new bearings to BMW factory tolerances, ensuring long-term reliability.

sections.heading: What BMW Engine Bearing Replacement Involves

blocks.html: Our bearing replacement service is performed as a core part of our full engine rebuilds, and can also be carried out as a standalone procedure where required. The process involves:

items: **Engine preparation** – we prepare the engine for bottom-end access, typically by removing the oil pan and any auxiliary components.
**Access to bearings** – for main bearings, the crankshaft or main bearing caps are removed; for rod bearings, the connecting rod caps are accessed through the oil pan.
**Removal of old bearings** – old bearing shells are carefully extracted from their housings.
**Journal inspection and measurement** – crankshaft journals are inspected for wear, then measured against BMW's factory tolerance specifications using micrometres and bore gauges.
**Installation of new bearings** – new bearings are fitted with the correct clearance, verified using plastigauge or precision micrometer readings.
**Reassembly and torque** – all components are reassembled and torqued to BMW's exact specifications.
**Oil system service** – the oil and filter are replaced to complete the process.

blocks.html: This work is carried out in our fully equipped workshop using specialist tools and genuine or OEM-grade replacement parts.

steps.title: Engine Preparation
steps.body: We prepare the engine for bottom-end access, safely supporting the vehicle and draining fluids.

steps.title: Oil Pan Removal
steps.body: The oil pan and any obstructions are removed to expose the main and connecting rod bearing caps.

steps.title: Bearing Cap Removal
steps.body: We remove the bearing caps and carefully extract the old bearing shells.

steps.title: Journal Inspection & Measurement
steps.body: Crankshaft journals are inspected for wear and measured against BMW factory tolerances using precision tools.

steps.title: New Bearing Installation
steps.body: New bearings are fitted with correct clearance, verified with plastigauge or micrometer readings.

steps.title: Reassembly & Torque
steps.body: All components are reassembled and torqued to BMW's exact specifications, including new bolts where required.

steps.title: Oil System Service
steps.body: We replace the oil and filter, and perform a final check before road testing.

We assess the engine and confirm if bearing replacement is the right course of action.

items.q: Do you replace both main bearings and connecting rod bearings?
items.a: Yes. Our service covers both main bearings and connecting rod bearings as part of a full engine rebuild. We can also perform a standalone bearing replacement on request.

items.q: Which BMW engines are most commonly serviced for bearing replacement?
items.a: We regularly perform bearing replacement on M-Power engines such as the S54, S65, S85, and S63, as well as high-mileage N55, N57, and B58 engines. The specific need depends on engine condition and mileage.

items.q: Is bearing replacement always part of a full rebuild?
items.a: In most cases, bearing replacement is included as part of our full engine rebuild service. However, we can also carry out a bearing-only replacement if the engine is otherwise in good condition.

items.q: What warranty do you offer on bearing replacement work?
items.a: All our rebuilds and bearing replacements come with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Terms and conditions apply.
